types.description: Harmony XB4 metal complete light body: white integral-LED light block + Zamak fixing collar / 24 V AC/DC steady pilot light

document.title: Schneider Electric Harmony XB4 metal control and signaling units, catalog
document.pages: Physical PDF p.88 (printed 86): Complete light bodies (fixing collar + light block with integral LED) lists 24 z / White / ZB4BVB1; physical PDF p.79 (printed 77): light block ZBVB1 (24 z, white, screw clamp)

modelingNotes: Exact identity. Harmony XB4 metal catalog 10/2021 (PDF p.88) lists ZB4BVB1 as 'Complete light body (fixing collar + light block with integral LED)', 24 z (AC/DC), White; the light block itself is ZBVB1 (24 z white, PDF p.79). Product datasheet 'ZB4BVB1' (9 May 2023) repeats: 'Complete body/light block assembly, Harmony XB4, metal, universal LED, body/fixing collar, 24V AC DC'. Manufacturer prints the code without a hyphen (ZB4BVB1); the type keeps the job order number ZB4-BVB1 and the hyphen is presentation only.

Scope: this reference is the body + Zamak fixing collar + white integral-LED light block (the electrical part). It does NOT include the operator lens/head; the complete panel pilot light is ZB4BVB1 + ZB4BV013 (catalog).

Terminals: two screw-clamp LED supply terminals marked X1 and X2 ('Terminals description ISO n°1 (X1-X2)', product datasheet 9 May 2023). No DC polarity is assigned. FAQ FA117146 names ZBVB1; it is not used as a universal guarantee for all body revisions. Screw clamp <= 2 x 1.5 mm2 with cable end / >= 1 x 0.22 mm2 without; tightening 0.8-1.2 N.m.

Function 'light' is the integral white LED load across X1-X2. It normally conducts but is a load, not a wire/jumper, so NO fixed link joins the two nets; load metadata never manufactures continuity. Both supply terminals are required (lamp/supply library policy).

Ratings: [Us] 24 V AC/DC at 50/60 Hz, signalling type Steady. rating.nominal_voltage = 24 encodes the fixed nominal and matches 24 V circuit intent; voltage_type is deliberately omitted because the block operates on BOTH AC and DC (no AC-only/DC-only metadata asserted). Documentation only, kept out of the scalar rating: supply limits 19.2-30 V DC / 21.6-26.4 V AC, current consumption 18 mA, [Ui] 600 V, [Uimp] 6 kV, service life 100000 h.

Coordinator scope: included metal collar/support protective bonding is not proven by Class I classification. No PE screw, automatic panel bond or exhaustive absence of an electrical attachment interface is asserted. Coverage remains partial.

Exact manufacturer ZB4BVB1 PDF dated12 September2026, 7 rear terminals;8 body-printed lamp diagram, was visually reviewed. The two screws are X1 and X2, and the side drawing shows a lamp between them. Its alternate artwork uses generic ZBV-XX/xx V placeholders; use it only for the matching two-terminal body interface, not exact electrical ratings, LED color or production revision. URL: https://www.se.com/au/en/product/download-pdf/ZB4BVB1

connectionCoverage.notes: Both documented lamp supply clamps X1 and X2 are represented. The included metal fixing collar/support bonding interface and its installed continuity remain unresolved and unmodeled. No dedicated PE endpoint, automatic panel bond or exhaustive absence of conductive attachments is asserted. Head/lens and added electrical blocks are separate.

X1.description: white LED supply terminal X1,24 V AC/DC; no DC polarity assigned

X2.description: white LED supply terminal X2,24 V AC/DC; no DC polarity assigned
